info.title: Envoi Muse-to-Hermes send test
info.description: Provisional single-recipient staging connector contract. The send action is a sensitive write and requires Meta's per-use approval. This document is for API review; it does not imply that Muse accepts OpenAPI import or can run unattended.

post.summary: Send one native Envoi message to the owner-approved Hermes agent
post.description: Uses a five-minute, one-message credential bound to this Muse agent and exact recipient. An identical retry returns the same canonical message. This action sends information to another agent; it is not an inbox read.

parameters.name: inboxId
parameters.description: Envoi inbox ID bound to the owner-approved grant

senderAgentId.description: Muse agent ID bound to the grant

recipientEmail.description: Exact Hermes address approved by the owner

text.description: The message the owner approves Muse to send

202.description: One canonical message accepted and queued; recipient processing is not yet confirmed

200.description: Exact retry returned the existing canonical message

401.description: Missing, expired, revoked, or already spent credential for a new action

403.description: Sender, recipient, or policy outside the approved grant

409.description: Credential or idempotency reuse conflicts with the original message

MuseSendTestBearer.description: Owner-approved, five-minute, single-message Muse send-test credential captured in the connector's private credential field
